evidence_grading.1: Primary — government publications, official statistics, official pricing pages, statutes, our own interviews/pilot data
evidence_grading.2: High-quality secondary — IIM/IIIT research, established consulting, World Bank/OECD, peer-reviewed
evidence_grading.3: Market intelligence — Tracxn, Crunchbase, Factly/Dataful, SaaS directories (G2, Capterra, GetApp)
evidence_grading.4: Community — vendor blogs, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, review-site excerpts

reliability_markers.VERIFIED: read directly from a primary source
reliability_markers.NOT_PUBLIC: gated behind login or sales call
reliability_markers.UNVERIFIED: could not be confirmed; do not cite externally

headline_findings: India digitised innovation ACCOUNTABILITY, not innovation OPERATIONS. Every mandated system is a compliance ledger keyed on events and snapshots; none is a system of record keyed on a venture over time.

The IIC portal has a menu item 'IPR/TTO Centres' that registers a TTO's existence and floor area - and has no field anywhere to record a single patent. Zero of 11 direct competitors have an IPR module.
The market is NOT empty. NestLens Orbit publishes INR 75,000/yr all-in. todo.md's assumed Rs 1.2L sits ABOVE the cheapest credible Indian incumbent.
Three capabilities have zero competitors across 11 vendors: IPR lifecycle, TRL as a first-class object, and YUKTI-NIR/IIC/ARIIA export. All three are MANDATED by India today.
The real competitor is free and it is WhatsApp. IISc's own IIC page links students to a WhatsApp group.
